role_agent_name: Port health and environmental safety auditor (HSE)
abstract: Maintains emergency transit corridor clearances and mandatory exclusion zone buffers
system_message:
You are Port health and environmental safety auditor (HSE). As the Port health and environmental safety auditor (HSE), you maintain official records concerning emergency transit corridor clearances and mandatory exclusion zone buffers across candidate facilities, alongside quayside spill prevention capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Quayside spill prevention（WASTE）
information_points.content:
HSE-WASTE-Z0J：According to port oil spill contingency drill logs for the inner harbour marine basin containment team, Dundee Renewable Marine Quayside demonstrates a rapid containment boom deployment time of 15 min.
HSE-WASTE-I0L：According to port oil spill contingency drill logs for the inner harbour marine basin containment team, Aberdeen South Harbour Terminal demonstrates a rapid containment boom deployment time of 35 min.
HSE-WASTE-8AJ：According to port oil spill contingency drill logs for the inner harbour marine basin containment team, Port of Leith Ocean Pavilion demonstrates a rapid containment boom deployment time of 25 min.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency transit corridor clearances and mandatory exclusion zone buffers（SAFE）
information_points.content:
HSE-SAFE-RTB：Under venue specification version Version 3 for Dundee Renewable Marine Quayside, the municipal emergency services access audit reflects that the emergency and public transit corridor is not cleared along the arterial dual-carriageway access gates. Additionally, the required mandatory safety perimeter clearance area for the candidate outdoor exhibition precinct is set at 5,500 m2.
HSE-SAFE-O7W：Under venue specification version Version 2 for Dundee Renewable Marine Quayside, the municipal emergency services access audit confirms that the emergency and public transit corridor is cleared along the arterial dual-carriageway access gates leading into the venue. In addition, the candidate outdoor exhibition precinct requires a mandatory safety perimeter clearance area of 4,500 m2 deducted for emergency lanes and swing radius envelopes.
HSE-SAFE-IRU：Under venue specification version Version 2 for Aberdeen South Harbour Terminal, the municipal emergency services access audit indicates that the emergency and public transit corridor is not cleared along the arterial dual-carriageway access gates leading into the venue. Furthermore, the mandatory safety perimeter clearance area for the outdoor exhibition precinct is established at 5,500 m2.
HSE-SAFE-I4R：Under venue specification version Version 2 for Port of Leith Ocean Pavilion, formal sign-off confirms that the emergency and public transit corridor is cleared along the arterial dual-carriageway access gates. The outdoor exhibition precinct zoning specification designates a mandatory safety perimeter clearance area of 4,500 m2.
